Exceptional Food, Impeccable Service, and a Memorable Dining Experience
Aug 2026 • Couples
We felt very welcome at Livannah and had an excellent dining experience from start to finish. The food quality and service we received were exemplary and made for a very special night out.

Food
All the dishes we ordered were expertly prepared, looked fantastic on their plates, and, most importantly, tasted delicious. Every component of each dish was well thought out and seasoned to perfection, so the flavors blended wonderfully.

What was consistent, though, was the quality of every dish served to us. Not one dish fell short of our expectations. In fact, every plate we were served was so full of flavor and so beautifully presented that we could not wait for the next dish.

Service
The service throughout the meal was, again, exceptional. The staff were all very friendly and attentive, showing a real passion for the restaurant and the experience they provide. This made for a relaxed meal, with staff always on hand when needed and then leaving us to enjoy our dining at a pace that suited us.

They demonstrated great professionalism, and the quality of service they provided allowed us to enjoy our meal and created a fantastic dining experience.

Overall Impression
An excellent dinner experience, combining first-class food with superior service. All the dishes that we ordered were of an extremely high standard, and we were treated with great respect and courtesy throughout our meal.

We would recommend Livannah to anyone looking for a high-quality dining experience; we cannot wait for our next visit!

Hidden Gem - WOW dining in the heart of Ho Chi Minh!
Dec 2025 • Couples
Just arrived in Ho Chi Minh and WOW … very impressed with the Livannah and the tasty bites! The Nori Tacos are a fantastic twist on a sushi type dish - we enjoyed the salmon and beef wagyu. We also shared the fried wanton tiger prawn and pork, stuffed chicken (street food) and the slow glazed pork ribs - again WOW tasting plates. And to top it off A Crunchy Havana’s Cigar dessert - such a unique item we ordered again.

Fantastic new restaurant, intimate.
Nov 2025 • Couples
Happened across Livannah on road between Opera House and our hotel Le Meridian. What a fantastic surprise. My wife and I hopped in for some small plates and a drink. Everything we ordered (prawn tacos, chicken tacos, rice/egg, ribs, chicken satay) had great flavor and freshness. Drinks were solid and the restaurant was very clean/nice/new. Upscale but simple/straightforward. We enjoyed the vibe (mellow), away from the noise and crowds just one block away. Super satisfied that we dropped in. Would highly recommend/do again
